stem.text: Some babies are born with a hole between the right and left atria. These babies are found to have an increased number of red blood cells.
What is the reason for this increase in red blood cells in these babies?

A.text: Blood is pumped faster, which causes more blood to circulate in the heart.

B.text: More blood is needed in the heart because the pressure is lower.

C.text: Their haemoglobin has a higher affinity for oxygen.

D.text: There is a lower oxygen concentration in the body of the newborn baby.
